assumptions: Lab 1: Ramu canonical (0.55 cr shares, ₹22 cr loan, 2.0x, ₹100); cover = S*P/L; call price = c*L/S
forced sales sell x=(cL-SP)/(P(c-1)) shares at the pre-impact price, then price falls k*proceeds (k = 0.5/1/2/4% per ₹1 cr, one-off); rounds stop when cover >= c-0.005 or after 8
Lab 2: sells 5% = 5 percentage points of company moved to the chosen buyer; pledges more = 25% of promoter holding (1.375 cr), one-off
Lab 3: seller price in paise steps, cups 10-160 cr in steps of 10, market ₹0.28 (one-off), sales 500, materiality = 10% of sales strictly exceeded, EBITDA 85, tax 25%
lab.independent_calculation_method: scratchpad/labtest.py: separate Python oracle (cascade solved by bisection per round, not the page's closed form) drives the page through Playwright and compares window.labResults / shareResults / rptResults and chart geometry
